```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'assets/**'
      - '.github/scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/advanced-translation-check.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  translation-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install gettext
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gettext
        shell: bash

      - name: Install translate-toolkit
        run: pip install translate-toolkit
        shell: bash

      - name: Run translate toolkit quality checks
        run: python .github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py
        shell: bash

      - name: Run advanced translation checks
        run: python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py
        shell: bash
```
